_note: Evolution Items (§6.3.2, §7.2.5, docs/design/catalogs/consumables.md §5). A stone is applied from the Move Manager between nodes, like a TM, and never enters the combat pile. It lets a line evolve before its level threshold — `fromLevel` — and opens the ordinary Evolution screen there; `branch` narrows that screen to the one branch the stone makes (Eevee's three). Single use.

items.name: Fire Stone
items.description: A stone with a heat that never fades. It evolves Vulpix, Growlithe and Eevee — into Flareon — ahead of their time.

items.name: Water Stone
items.description: A clear blue stone that feels wet to the touch. It evolves Eevee into Vaporeon, and Shellder, Staryu and Poliwhirl early.

items.name: Thunder Stone
items.description: A green stone with a thunderbolt caught inside. It evolves Eevee into Jolteon, and Pikachu early.

items.name: Leaf Stone
items.description: A stone with a leaf pattern grown into it. It evolves Exeggcute, Gloom and Weepinbell early.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.description: A stone as black as the night it fell from. It evolves Clefairy, Jigglypuff, Nidorina and Nidorino early.
